create_AccelerateParallelBackend: create an AccelerateParallelBackend instance for distributed data parallel training with configurable world size and backend
apply_ddp_model: apply distributed data parallel wrapping to a PyTorch model using the AccelerateParallelBackend
create_AccelerateCheckpointer: create an AccelerateCheckpointer to save and load training checkpoints with step-based rotation and limit
prepare_dataloader_dataset: prepare a PyTorch DataLoader for distributed training with configurable batch size and worker count
get_device_mesh: get a distributed device mesh for data parallelism with optional replication and sharding dimensions
